An Economist/YouGov poll released Aug. 11 found that 33% of Americans approve of Trump’s job performance, a 3-percentage-point drop from the previous week, reported USA TODAY. The latest figure marks Trump’s lowest approval rating in YouGov polling since he returned to the White House in 2025. [...] The economy continues to weigh on Trump’s approval numbers, as it has in several recent polls. The Economist/YouGov poll found that just 22% of Americans rate the economy as excellent or good, while only 14% say economic conditions are improving.

Meanwhile, more than half of Americans — 56% — believe the economy is getting worse.

The Economist/YouGov poll was conducted Aug. 7-10 among 1,589 U.S

Donald Trump’s net approval rating has fallen to -27, a new record low, according to The Economist’s tracker of YouGov polling. The administration’s resumption of strikes on Iran in mid-July may be to blame. Since then both sides have been locked in a cycle of fighting and half-baked attempts at a ceasefire. Still, by this point, most Americans will not be surprised by Mr Trump’s failure to reach a face-saving settlement to re-open the Strait of Hormuz. results.content:
The latest survey from The Economist/YouGov, published Monday, found 33 percent of respondents said they approved of how Trump has handled his job as president. Another 62 percent indicated they disapproved.

Support for the president was split largely along partisan lines, with 79 percent of GOP respondents and only 4 percent of Democratic respondents approving of Trump’s job performance, according to the poll. [...] The Economist’s polling tracker, which uses data from YouGov surveys, reported in June that Trump had become the most unpopular president ever in the poll with a net approval rating of negative 25 percentage points.
